reduced.safetensors holds seeded random weights (seed 20261028) in the
shapes and under the tensor names of a GLiNER2 checkpoint: the encoder is
core/tests/fixtures/deberta's, the relation heads are at width 32. No value
comes from a GLiNER2 or DeBERTa checkpoint. reduced.json holds the outputs
of GLiNER2's own layer classes on those weights.

real.json holds only outputs of fastino/gliner2-base-v1 at
f9634218e53580c56edf0de97ca1a7d3f1c2354e (Apache-2.0 weights, local-only by
its training data, docs/licences.md); no weights.

Both were produced by analysis/relation/reference/gliner2/build_fixture.py
with GLiNER2 (Apache-2.0) at ca4f68235b50fe4c3ecf3876851d748fe4b15c6c and
Hugging Face Transformers 4.57.1 (Apache-2.0).
